expertCleansProSystem.name: Expert Cleans Pro-System
expertCleansProSystem.description: Double Dimension Cleansing System — a gentle surface and deep cleanse. Cleansing, an enzyme or fruit-acid peel suited to your skin, steam, extraction, mask, and finishing care. Suited to all skin types, especially congested skin.

clearBalance.name: Clear Balance
clearBalance.description: A specially developed deep cleanse that targets the three main causes of blemished skin. Suited to hyperkeratosis, excess oil production, and infection-prone skin.

aquatermRecovery.name: Aquaterm Recovery
aquatermRecovery.description: A stabilizing, balancing facial for sensitive skin that guards against redness and swelling. Every Aquaterm product is made with mineral thermal water from the Salies-de-Béarn spring. Suited to all skin types, including couperose or easily reactive skin.

powerHyaluronicDynamic.name: Power Hyaluronic – HA Dynamic
powerHyaluronicDynamic.description: An intensive moisture treatment that rebalances the skin's hydrodynamics, reaching an optimal hydration level in every layer. Delivers deep, lasting moisture and guards against premature water loss, strengthening the skin's own barrier. Suited to all skin types.

powerHyaluronicEyeContour.name: Power Hyaluronic – HA Eye Contour
powerHyaluronicEyeContour.description: An eye treatment that rejuvenates the eye contour with a lifting effect on the eyelids and works against contour wrinkles. Reduces under-eye bags and strengthens and nourishes the lashes.

powerCPlus.name: Power C+ (Brightening Antioxidant)
powerCPlus.description: A treatment with highly concentrated antioxidants for radiant, revitalized, visibly younger-looking skin. Suited to dull, devitalized skin and sun-aged skin.

powerRetinol.name: Power Retinol – Intensive Repairing Programme
powerRetinol.description: Rejuvenates naturally or sun-aged skin. Supports skin structure, refines pores, and stimulates collagen production, while supporting the skin's own healing process for inflammation. Suited to all skin types, mature skin, and acne-prone skin.

globalLift.name: Global Lift (ProGEN-in)
globalLift.description: An innovative global anti-aging strategy designed to cosmetically firm deeper cell layers with progressive tightening actives, for a more oval facial contour and against a double chin. Includes an ultrasound treatment. Suited to mature skin.

correctiveProgramm.name: Corrective Programme
correctiveProgramm.description: A cosmetic alternative — or an ideal complement — to aesthetic medicine. A fusion of three mechanisms (peel, filler, decontraction) intensively smooths wrinkles, rejuvenates expression, and restores a smooth, youthful look. Nine key actives, including botox-like peptides, snake venom, and hyaluronic-acid filler. Includes an ultrasound treatment. Suited to mature skin.

intensiveHydratingTreatment.name: Intensive Hydrating Treatment
intensiveHydratingTreatment.description: A moisture-replenishing treatment for men's skin left dry or damaged by extreme weather.

expressEnergizingTreatment.name: Express Energizing Treatment
expressEnergizingTreatment.description: An energizing treatment with oxygen-releasing components that revitalizes tired or stress-worn skin.

bacialBackTreatment.name: Bacial – Back Treatment
bacialBackTreatment.description: Cleansing, peel, steam, extraction, mask, and finishing care.

intensivAmpullen.name: Intensive Ampoules
intensivAmpullen.description: Uniqcure Hi-Tech concentrates — highly concentrated actives, matched to your skin's specific needs.

eyeContourPatches.name: Eye Contour Patches — Express Care
eyeContourPatches.description: Refreshes the eye contour for an instant anti-fatigue effect.

diamondPeel.name: Diamond Microdermabrasion Peel
diamondPeel.description: A gentle cleanse and effective peel using diamond tips for a deeper resurfacing of the skin's outer layer. Suited to anti-aging and acne treatment. Stimulates collagen production.

ultrasoundTreatment.name: Ultrasound Treatment (approx. 10 min)
ultrasoundTreatment.description: Boosts circulation and helps actives absorb; the micro-massage stimulates cell metabolism and works against lines, wrinkles, and slack skin. Supports skin regeneration from acne and inflammation.

browShaping.name: Brow Shaping, With or Without Wax

footCareClassic.name: Foot Care Classic
footCareClassic.description: A foot bath, removal of calluses and pressure spots by scalpel, corn removal, trimming and shaping the toenails, tamponade for ingrown toenails if needed, cuticle care, and finishing care.

acuteAppointment.name: Acute Appointment — Pain or Growth Guidance
acuteAppointment.description: For problem toes or ongoing pressure pain: cleaning and disinfecting the nail or pressure spot, treating the source of pain, tamponade if needed, aftercare guidance, and a follow-up discussion.

nailBrace.name: Nail Brace (BS Adhesive Brace)
nailBrace.description: A gentle correction of nail growth for chronically ingrown toenails using a BS adhesive brace.

nailProsthetics.name: Nail Prosthetics
nailProsthetics.description: Painless reconstruction of a partly missing or damaged nail using UV gel material. Once reconstructed, the nail can be polished as usual.

toenailPolish.name: Toenail Polish
toenailPolish.description: Choose from our on-trend, high-quality color range.

manicureClassic.name: Classic Manicure
manicureClassic.description: A hand bath, trimming and shaping the nails, cleaning, polishing and sealing the nail plate, cuticle care, and pressure-spot relief in the palm if needed. Finished with cuticle oil and a strengthening nail serum.

smallNailService.name: Small Nail Service
smallNailService.description: Trimming and shaping the nails, finished with nail oil.

nailPolish.name: Nail Polish
nailPolish.description: Choose your favorite shade from current trends and classics.

shellacManicure.name: Shellac UV Manicure
shellacManicure.description: Includes removal of any existing shellac. Choose your shade from a wide color range — no drying time needed. Nails cleaned, shaped, cuticles cared for, shellac applied, finishing care.

shellacRemoval.name: Shellac Removal
shellacRemoval.description: Without a fresh UV shellac polish. Shellac gently lifted with remover and remover wraps, nails shaped, finished with a strengthening nail serum and cuticle oil.

paraffinWithTreatment.name: Paraffin Bath — Add-on to a Treatment
paraffinWithTreatment.description: After a thorough cleanse and disinfection, hands are dipped in soothing warm liquid paraffin and wrapped in mitts for around 20 minutes. The occlusive effect boosts circulation, relaxes, and eases discomfort, leaving skin ready to better absorb what comes next.

paraffinAlone.name: Paraffin Bath — Standalone
paraffinAlone.description: A warming treatment in soothing liquid paraffin that boosts circulation, relaxes, and eases discomfort.

book.subhead: Reach out and we'll find a time that suits you.

parking.question: Is parking available?
parking.answer: Yes. Convenient parking is available in the Westfield Donau Zentrum parking garage. Guests can enjoy discounted parking by using the Westfield app, making their visit even more convenient.

bookingRequired.question: Do I need to book an appointment?
bookingRequired.answer: Yes, appointments are required. Depending on how flexible you are with your preferred days and times, we recommend booking your appointment 1 to 3 weeks in advance to ensure the best availability.

howToBook.question: How can I book an appointment?
howToBook.answer: You can book an appointment by calling us at {phone}. We will be happy to assist you in finding a convenient date and time for your visit.

cancelReschedule.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
cancelReschedule.answer: Yes, you may cancel or reschedule your appointment. We kindly request at least 24 hours' notice so that we have the opportunity to offer your appointment time to another client. We appreciate your understanding.

lateArrival.question: What happens if I arrive late?
lateArrival.answer: If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, we may need to shorten your treatment to avoid delaying the next appointments. In some cases, we may need to reschedule your appointment for another day. Thank you for your understanding.

treatmentFrequency.question: How often should I have a foot care treatment?
treatmentFrequency.answer: We generally recommend scheduling a foot care treatment every 4 to 5 weeks. However, the ideal interval depends on your individual needs and any specific foot concerns you may have. We will assess your condition during your visit and recommend a personalized treatment schedule that is best suited to you.

fungalNails.question: Do you treat fungal nail infections?
fungalNails.answer: Yes, we offer professional treatment and care for fungal nail infections and will recommend the most suitable treatment plan based on your individual needs.

ownNailPolish.question: If I bring my own nail polish, do I still have to pay for the nail polish application?
ownNailPolish.answer: Yes. You are welcome to bring your own nail polish if you have a preferred color. However, the nail polish application service will still be charged, as the fee covers the time and professional application rather than the nail polish itself. We also offer a wide selection of nail polish colors for you to choose from.

paymentMethods.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept cash and debit card payments. Credit card payments are accepted for transactions of €150 or more.

paragraphs.founding: Since 2014, our family-owned business in Vienna's Donaustadt district has stood for quality, expertise, and personal care. Our passion for beauty treatments and foot care is not just our profession—it is our vocation.
paragraphs.personal: I have been practicing my profession with great joy, dedication, and passion for over 30 years. During this time, I have had the privilege of caring for many clients and gaining valuable experience. Today, it fills me with great pride to pass on this knowledge and passion to the next generation.
paragraphs.team: Today, we run our business together as a mother-and-daughter team. By combining decades of experience with fresh ideas and modern expertise, we are able to blend proven techniques with innovative treatment methods. This allows us to create a warm, welcoming atmosphere where every client feels comfortable, understood, and well cared for.
paragraphs.training: To provide the highest quality treatments, we place great importance on continuous professional development. By regularly attending seminars, workshops, refresher courses, and advanced training programs, we continuously expand our knowledge and stay up to date with the latest developments in beauty therapy and foot care.
paragraphs.hygiene: The health and well-being of your skin and feet are our highest priorities. That is why we work according to the highest standards of hygiene and quality, offer personalized consultations, and continuously improve our quality management.
paragraphs.credential: As a member of the Austrian Federal Economic Chamber (WKO), we comply with all professional and quality standards and are committed to professionalism, safety, and trust.
